label: Modo de progressão
definition: Regra geral pela qual uma unidade pode ser considerada avançada no percurso.
precedence: rights/accessibility > consent > protocol > institution > author > learner > default
recommendation: Separar avanço estrutural de mastery; usar structural-completion no perfil AraLearn.
incompatibilities: criterion-gated without declared evidence or remediation
analytics_implication: Progression events do not establish learning unless the governing criterion says so.
accessibility_implication: Locks and alternative paths must be operable with assistive technology.

label: Semântica do estado
definition: Significado formal de estados como não iniciado, em andamento, concluído, proficiente ou dominado.
precedence: protocol/institution may lock labels; product must preserve distinction between structural and evidential states
recommendation: Proibir que complete, mastered e passed sejam sinônimos implícitos.
incompatibilities: mastery-claimed without criterion and evidence scope
analytics_implication: State transitions need interpretation rules before aggregation.
accessibility_implication: Status labels and visual states need non-color alternatives.

label: Base de evidência da progressão
definition: Tipo de evidência exigida para liberar ou recomendar avanço.
precedence: accessibility accommodation may alter response form but must preserve or qualify construct
recommendation: Exigir valor explícito em qualquer progression.mode diferente de open/structural.
incompatibilities: mastery claim from structural completion alone
analytics_implication: Evidence basis determines permitted inference and comparison.
accessibility_implication: Equivalent accessible evidence may replace an inaccessible response mode with annotation.

label: Critério de progressão
definition: Regra versionada que decide se a evidência é suficiente.
precedence: protocol/institution locks; author controls ordinary courses; learner cannot weaken locked criterion
recommendation: Aceitar a dimensão, rejeitar threshold universal; registrar versão, janela e domínio.
incompatibilities: criterion without source, version or horizon
analytics_implication: Threshold changes invalidate direct comparisons unless versioned.
accessibility_implication: Timed criteria require accommodation and construct review.

label: Escopo da evidência
definition: Unidade conceitual e temporal à qual o critério se aplica.
precedence: narrower scope cannot silently justify broader mastery claim
recommendation: Declarar escopo; mastery local não deve virar habilidade global.
incompatibilities: none
analytics_implication: Scope is required for valid outcome aggregation.
accessibility_implication: Accommodation effect must be recorded at the same scope.

label: Política de remediação
definition: Ação oferecida quando o critério não é atendido.
precedence: safety/accessibility > protocol > institution > author; learner chooses among permitted options
recommendation: Toda hard gate deve possuir remediação e saída segura.
incompatibilities: hard lock with no remediation or appeal
analytics_implication: Remediation actions must not be interpreted as deficit without protocol.
accessibility_implication: Alternate paths must remain accessible and offline-aware.

label: Política de override
definition: Quem pode liberar, adiar ou contornar uma restrição de progressão e com que registro.
precedence: accessibility/legal > consent > protocol exception > institution > author > learner
recommendation: Permitir override explícito, nunca bypass silencioso.
incompatibilities: silent bypass or irreversible lock without appeal
analytics_implication: Override is a governance event, not evidence of mastery.
accessibility_implication: Accessibility override may be mandatory and sensitive.

label: Política de rechecagem
definition: Quando um estado evidencial precisa ser confirmado, expira ou pode ser revisto.
precedence: protocol/institution locks; learner may request recheck in personal profile
recommendation: Separar mastery claim de permanência; permitir rechecagem sem apagar história.
incompatibilities: permanent mastery inferred from one event
analytics_implication: Rechecks may support retention estimates only with declared design.
accessibility_implication: Recheck burden and timing need accommodation.

label: Autoridade sobre a sequência
definition: Agente que determina a ordem efetiva das unidades disponíveis.
precedence: accessibility/legal > protocol > institution > author > learner > default > technical availability
recommendation: Separar autoridade de sequência de controle de ritmo; shared-control é recomendado para perfis pessoais guiados.
incompatibilities: learner-control treated as universally beneficial
analytics_implication: Sequence changes must be identifiable in research conditions.
accessibility_implication: Navigation order and alternatives must remain keyboard/screen-reader accessible.

label: Política de pré-requisitos
definition: Força e comportamento das dependências entre unidades.
precedence: accessibility exception > protocol > institution > author; learner may override only soft policies
recommendation: Usar dependências explícitas; hard lock não deve ser default pessoal.
incompatibilities: cycles, dead ends or unavailable prerequisite without alternative
analytics_implication: Prerequisite violations are not automatically failure events.
accessibility_implication: Locks require accessible explanation and recovery path.

label: Política de ordenação
definition: Estrutura usada para organizar unidades disponíveis.
precedence: protocol/institution > author > learner within permitted space
recommendation: Preservar ordem autoral como referência; admitir recomendação e reordenação sem confundir com mastery.
incompatibilities: adaptive-ranked without transparency or fallback
analytics_implication: Order is a condition variable in comparative studies.
accessibility_implication: Alternative order must preserve equivalent access to required content.

label: Política de ramificação
definition: Como o percurso oferece caminhos alternativos após escolha, evidência ou contexto.
precedence: protocol/institution locks branches; learner selects among visible permitted paths
recommendation: Aceitar como dimensão; adiar branching adaptativo automático.
incompatibilities: opaque branch or branch without return path
analytics_implication: Branch assignment can confound outcomes and must be recorded when studied.
accessibility_implication: Branches need equivalent navigation and clear rejoin semantics.

label: Política de intercalação
definition: Modo de alternar categorias, operações ou tópicos para promover discriminação.
precedence: protocol > institution > author; learner may choose only when unlocked
recommendation: Intercalar somente com objetivo discriminativo e domínio plausível; não usar universalmente.
incompatibilities: random mixing without category model or prerequisite foundation
analytics_implication: Interleaving must be separated from spacing in analysis.
accessibility_implication: Mixed categories need accessible labels and orientation.

label: Snapshot da sequência efetiva
definition: Registro versionado da ordem, locks, ramificações e overrides aplicados a uma execução.
precedence: protocol/institution for locked runs; product for personal state
recommendation: Exigir snapshot para pesquisa e comparação; opcional em uso pessoal simples.
incompatibilities: research comparison without effective sequence record
analytics_implication: Needed to reproduce conditions without storing unnecessary behavior.
accessibility_implication: Snapshot must avoid sensitive labels unless required.

label: Autoridade sobre o ritmo
definition: Quem controla quando avançar, pausar e retomar dentro dos limites da sequência.
precedence: accessibility > protocol > institution > author > learner
recommendation: Usar learner-paced no perfil AraLearn; não inferir que isso autoriza reordenar conteúdo.
incompatibilities: system pacing without pause or accommodation
analytics_implication: Pacing affects time and exposure; record only when decision-relevant.
accessibility_implication: Pause and replay controls are accessibility requirements in relevant media.

label: Política de prazo e disponibilidade
definition: Como datas, janelas e ritmo institucional limitam o percurso.
precedence: accessibility and approved exceptions may extend; protocol windows require documented deviation
recommendation: Aceitar para contextos formais; manter none no perfil pessoal.
incompatibilities: hard expiry that destroys local study state
analytics_implication: Deadlines are consequences/policies, not mastery evidence.
accessibility_implication: Extensions and time-zone behavior require accessible implementation.

label: Gatilho de revisão
definition: Evento ou decisão que cria uma oportunidade de revisão.
precedence: protocol/institution > author > learner; adaptive only when authorized
recommendation: Manter marcação do estudante e retomadas autorais; aceitar outros gatilhos sem coleta automática.
incompatibilities: hidden trigger based on unauthorized telemetry
analytics_implication: Trigger source must be known before interpreting review participation.
accessibility_implication: Learner-marked review is private unless shared explicitly.

label: Política de agenda de revisão
definition: Como oportunidades de revisão são distribuídas no tempo ou percurso.
precedence: research protocol/institution > author > learner; adaptive candidate not normative
recommendation: Aceitar agenda explícita; adiar escolha de algoritmo adaptativo para #6/#7.
incompatibilities: adaptive scheduler treated as evidence-based universal default
analytics_implication: Schedule must be versioned in research conditions.
accessibility_implication: Offline queue must preserve due items without coercive notifications.

label: Padrão de intervalos
definition: Representação dos intervalos entre exposições ou recuperações.
precedence: protocol locks; author controls ordinary course; learner may customize personal profile
recommendation: Não escolher equal ou expanding universalmente; registrar unidade e origem.
incompatibilities: interval without unit, exposure definition or retention goal
analytics_implication: Interval pattern is not meaningful without outcome horizon.
accessibility_implication: Time-based rules need locale and accessibility safeguards.

label: Horizonte de retenção
definition: Período ou marco para o qual a revisão pretende sustentar disponibilidade do conhecimento.
precedence: protocol/institution > author > learner in personal use
recommendation: Exigir em qualquer recomendação de spacing; permitir unspecified apenas em perfil manual simples.
incompatibilities: claim of optimal interval without horizon
analytics_implication: Outcome timing must match the declared horizon.
accessibility_implication: Date targets need time-zone and calendar accessibility.

label: Orçamento de revisão
definition: Limite de carga por sessão, dia, janela ou fila.
precedence: accessibility/health > protocol > institution > author > learner
recommendation: Aceitar como dimensão de frugalidade; não usar tempo estimado como medida de esforço.
incompatibilities: unbounded mandatory queue
analytics_implication: Queue load must not become an inferred engagement metric.
accessibility_implication: Learner needs pause, defer and reduced-load accommodations.

label: Política de adiamento
definition: Como o estudante pode adiar, ignorar ou redistribuir revisões.
precedence: accessibility > protocol > institution > author > learner
recommendation: Free-defer no perfil pessoal; restrições somente em curso/protocolo explícito.
incompatibilities: penalty inferred from defer in non-consequential study
analytics_implication: Deferral is not evidence of disengagement or deficit.
accessibility_implication: Deferral controls must be reachable and understandable.

label: Relação entre item de revisão e evidência anterior
definition: Grau de identidade ou transferência entre oportunidades.
precedence: protocol > institution > author; learner can request variation in personal profile
recommendation: Distinguir repetição, equivalente e transferência; não declarar mastery por item idêntico apenas.
incompatibilities: equivalence claimed without domain rule or review
analytics_implication: Required to interpret retention and transfer outcomes.
accessibility_implication: Equivalent accessible item may change modality with construct annotation.

label: Política após dificuldade em revisão
definition: Resposta do sistema quando a evidência em revisão não atende ao critério.
precedence: accessibility > protocol > institution > author > learner
recommendation: Não apagar conclusão estrutural; reabrir mastery apenas se a política assim definir.
incompatibilities: silent downgrade or punitive lock in personal profile
analytics_implication: Failure handling can change the intervention and must be recorded.
accessibility_implication: Support must remain accessible and non-stigmatizing.

label: Disponibilidade de exemplo resolvido
definition: Quando um exemplo completo ou parcial pode ser consultado.
precedence: protocol/institution > author > learner; accessibility may require equivalent explanation
recommendation: Exemplos recomendados para novatos e tarefas complexas; disponibilidade não deve ser universal.
incompatibilities: summative measurement with unrestricted example access
analytics_implication: Example access changes practice condition and must be recorded when studied.
accessibility_implication: Examples need accessible alternatives for visual or symbolic steps.

label: Posição do exemplo
definition: Relação temporal entre exemplo, tentativa e problema independente.
precedence: protocol > institution > author
recommendation: Recomendar example-before-problem para novatos estruturados, mas exigir problema independente na sequência.
incompatibilities: worked-examples-only profile for skill mastery without later active problem solving
analytics_implication: Position is an experimental condition and affects comparison.
accessibility_implication: Navigation between example and problem must preserve context.

label: Completude do exemplo
definition: Quantidade de solução, decisão e justificativa já fornecida.
precedence: protocol > author; learner may request more support if allowed
recommendation: Usar complete/faded conforme expertise e tarefa; nunca remover dados necessários do problema.
incompatibilities: missing essential task information mislabeled as fading
analytics_implication: Completeness affects cognitive demand and outcome interpretation.
accessibility_implication: Partial examples need accessible indication of missing steps.

label: Explicação do exemplo
definition: Conteúdo explicativo que acompanha passos e decisões.
precedence: protocol > author; learner controls optional prompts where permitted
recommendation: Evitar exemplos ambíguos e sem racional; prompts não devem ser obrigatórios universalmente.
incompatibilities: long generic explanation causing redundancy
analytics_implication: Explanation type is distinct from example presence.
accessibility_implication: Prompts and rationale need language and screen-reader support.

label: Tipo de scaffold
definition: Função do apoio temporário oferecido durante tarefa ou percurso.
precedence: protocol/institution > author; learner can request optional support
recommendation: Aceitar tipos separados; não tratar toda ajuda como hint.
incompatibilities: scaffold with no target or exit condition
analytics_implication: Support type affects mechanism and confounds.
accessibility_implication: Alternative accessible scaffolds may be required.

label: Acesso ao scaffold
definition: Como e quando o apoio é disponibilizado.
precedence: accessibility > protocol > institution > author > learner > adaptive candidate
recommendation: Learner-request e autoria explícita no primeiro perfil; adiar detecção automática de struggle.
incompatibilities: support triggered by unauthorized behavioral inference
analytics_implication: Trigger cannot be interpreted without governance and measurement validity.
accessibility_implication: Access must be possible without fine motor precision or hidden gestures.

label: Política de retirada de apoio
definition: Regra para reduzir, manter ou restaurar scaffolds.
precedence: accessibility > protocol > institution > author > learner
recommendation: Aceitar fading, mas rejeitar superioridade universal; garantir restauração e versionamento.
incompatibilities: automatic fading from unvalidated mastery estimate
analytics_implication: Fading changes treatment and must be captured in research snapshots.
accessibility_implication: Restoration is an accessibility and error-recovery requirement.

label: Política de segmentação
definition: Critério para dividir conteúdo e prática em unidades coerentes.
precedence: protocol > author > learner
recommendation: Manter segmentos semanticamente coerentes; rejeitar microconteúdo arbitrário.
incompatibilities: fragmentation that removes prerequisites or context
analytics_implication: Segment definition changes exposure and time.
accessibility_implication: Segment boundaries must not trap focus or hide content.

label: Controle dos segmentos
definition: Quem avança, pausa, retorna ou reproduz segmentos.
precedence: accessibility > protocol > author > learner
recommendation: Learner pace como referência; system pace somente com pausa/replay e justificativa.
incompatibilities: unpausable system pace for nonessential timing
analytics_implication: Control affects learning time and must be distinct from sequence authority.
accessibility_implication: Pause, replay and keyboard operation are required where applicable.

label: Estado de retomada
definition: Informação funcional mínima preservada para continuar após interrupção.
precedence: privacy/accessibility > product default; protocol may restrict stored input
recommendation: Preservar cursor e estado local necessário; não coletar histórico comportamental.
incompatibilities: state loss or resume based only on recent telemetry
analytics_implication: Functional state is not engagement evidence.
accessibility_implication: Local state and recovery must work with assistive technology.

label: Pista de contexto na retomada
definition: Informação apresentada para reativar objetivo e posição após interrupção.
precedence: accessibility > learner preference > author/product default
recommendation: Exibir objetivo e posição; permitir resumo anterior e próximo passo sem gerar conteúdo novo automaticamente.
incompatibilities: context cue that reveals assessment answer
analytics_implication: Cue usage must not be treated as difficulty signal.
accessibility_implication: Cue must be concise, perceivable and non-disruptive.

label: Apoio de reentrada
definition: Ação opcional oferecida quando a pessoa retorna após pausa significativa.
precedence: protocol > author > learner in locked study; learner default otherwise
recommendation: Aceitar learner-choice no perfil móvel; adiar seleção automática por duração.
incompatibilities: automatic remedial branch inferred from absence duration
analytics_implication: Reentry option changes exposure and should be explicit in research.
accessibility_implication: Choices must not stigmatize or require disclosure of absence reason.
